An unnamed [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bartokk]] species; a race of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] which function through a [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]].

==Description==
A rocky world, the planet was not named by the Bartokk and its location was not plotted on any official [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]]. Lightly irradiated by the nearby [[Star/Legends|star]], the planet's natives sometimes were born with slight defects that were considered abhorrent by the hive societies. Any Bartokk deformed by the radiation were exiled from the hive to die in the arid wilderness or travel offworld to find employ as soldiers.<ref name="UAA" />
